info.name: Core API integration tests
info.description: End-to-end smoke tests replayed by newman in CI (MAIR-117). `baseUrl` is injected by docker-compose-integration.yml; the default in environment.json targets a local stack. The flow creates a fresh user through the admin route (unique e-mail generated at run time), walks the first-connection password change, logs in, and exercises the session routes with the issued JWT, then archives the account through the admin route (JWT of the seeded Admin forged in the pre-request script).

exec: // One fresh account per run so the collection is replayable against a persistent database.
// Admin routes need the seeded Admin (user 1), who has no known password: forge its JWT exactly
// like mairie360_api_lib::jwt_manager does (HS256, claims { sub, role, exp }), signed with the
// JWT_SECRET of the stack, injected by docker-compose-integration.yml (random per run, MAIR-428).
const payload = b64url(cryptoJs.enc.Utf8.parse(JSON.stringify({ sub: String(pm.environment.get('admin_user_id')), role: '', exp: Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) + 3600 })));

item.name: Session JWT signed by Core (MAIR-680)
item.description: MAIR-680: only Core signs session JWTs, with its Ed25519 key (EdDSA, kid, iss mairie360-core, aud mairie360); the other services hold the public key only. The stack signs with this run's key pair (stack_secrets.sh); JWT_SECRET is still set for the transition, so the HS256 admin JWT of the collection keeps working.
